releaseNotes: Redesigned Anime Tracker around a media-focused watchlist and detailed anime workspace.
Added integrated AniList search, richer cover artwork, airing details, and streamlined list importing.
Improved Anime Tracker responsiveness with persistent artwork caching and virtualized large episode lists.
Fixed search popup repaint issues and several Anime Tracker scrolling and alignment problems.
Improved Auto Clicker keyboard output reliability for games and other applications.
